The '''Bynarria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Bynarrian jig]] dance, which was created<ref name="LostLegacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Bynarrian jig]]|system=Bynarria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="date">The [[Bynarrian jig]] appears in the novel ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]'', the events of which are dated by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' to between [[2 BBY/Legends|2]] to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bynarria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-8.<ref name="TEA" />
